title: Meta-Learning Where to Allocate Experts: Task-Conditioned Layer-Wise Compression for MoEs
abstract: arXiv:2608.26650v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models route each token to a subset of expert networks, increasing capacity while keeping per-token computation sparse. In many deployed MoEs, the number of active experts is fixed across layers and tasks, although layer roles and expert redundancy vary with depth and demand varies with difficulty. Existing approaches address only part of this setting: layer-wise allocations are usually determined offline and reused for all tasks, while token-level methods vary expert activation using local routing signals without task-level context. We propose MetaNet, a support-set controller that predicts, for each layer, an expert-retention threshold and a bounded routing bias. The backbone, experts, and router remain frozen. On DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Chat, MetaNet provides a tunable accuracy-expert-activation trade-off. translated_title: 元学习专家分配位置：基于任务条件的MoE分层压缩
translated_abstract: 混合专家（MoE）模型将每个标记路由到专家网络的子集，在增加容量的同时保持每标记计算的稀疏性。在许多已部署的MoE中，活跃专家数量在层和任务间是固定的，尽管层角色和专家冗余随深度变化，需求随难度变化。现有方法仅解决该设置的一部分：层间分配通常离线确定并复用于所有任务，而令牌级方法使用局部路由信号变化专家激活，缺乏任务级上下文。我们提出MetaNet，一种支持集控制器，为每层预测专家保留阈值和有界路由偏差。骨干网络、专家和路由器保持冻结。在DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Chat上，MetaNet提供了可调的准确性-专家激活权衡。相对于固定k=6，保守设置平均激活3.61个专家（减少40%），并达到可比性能。
tldr: 本文提出MetaNet，一种任务条件化的分层压缩方法，通过元学习预测每层的专家保留阈值和路由偏差，在冻结模型参数下实现可调的准确率-专家激活权衡，减少约40%的专家激活而保持性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MetaNet, a task-conditioned layer-wise compression method that meta-learns expert-retention thresholds and routing biases per layer, achieving a tunable accuracy-expert-activation trade-off with ~40% fewer active experts while maintaining comparable performance on DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Chat.
